The doctor inserts the forefinger in the anal canal to check the size of the prostate gland. Question: Do I have to perform ghusl after the prostate exam? The doctor inserts the forefinger in the anal canal to check the size of the prostate gland. Answer ID: 145950 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 164/144/L=2/1438) No, no ghusl shall be wajib merely by inserting the finger in the anal passage: وعرف بهذا عدم الوجوب بإيلاج الإصبع - ردالمحتار 1/300 كتاب الطهارة ط : زكريا بكڈپو دیوبند یوپی ہندوستان Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
